tools.name: search_studies
tools.description: Find molecular hydrogen studies by keywords and/or filters. Returns compact study records (design, subject, sample size, delivery method, outcome, key finding, url). Sorted by relevance when a query is given, otherwise by strength of evidence.

tools.name: get_study
tools.description: Full record for one study: citation, design, population, H2 protocol (delivery, concentration, dosage), outcome, our plain-language summary and key finding, limitations, quality score with red flags, conditions/mechanisms, and links. Accepts an id, slug, DOI or study URL.

tools.name: get_condition_evidence
tools.description: Evidence profile for a health condition hub: how many studies, human vs animal vs in-vitro, number of human RCTs and participants, outcome mix, delivery methods, publication years, data coverage, and the strongest studies.

tools.name: compare_evidence
tools.description: Side-by-side evidence profiles for 2–4 groups of studies, e.g. inhalation vs drinking water for one condition, or two conditions. Each group is a set of filters merged over the optional shared filters.

tools.name: aggregate_studies
tools.description: Count matching studies grouped by year, subject, design, delivery_method, outcome, country, condition or species — for trends and 'how many' questions. Unknown values are counted separately.

tools.name: find_related_studies
tools.description: Studies a given study cites, studies that cite it, and the most similar studies by shared health conditions.

tools.name: list_conditions
tools.description: Every health condition hub with its study count, evidence grade (where reviewed) and page URL. Use the slug as the `condition` filter.

tools.name: get_database_stats
tools.description: Size and makeup of the database: total studies, breakdown by subject and design, year range, and field coverage.
